specs.label: Ray / Draw collapsed tab — open dialog
specs.note: The render feature mounts collapsed as a `.render__tab` button in the viewport region; clicking it expands the Draw/Ray setup form (RenderDialog.tsx:225-236, 105). Leaves the dialog OPEN for the specs that follow (state persists across specs on the shared page).

specs.label: Lock aspect ratio checkbox — turn OFF unlocks the ratio
specs.note: Lock is ON by default (useRenderForm INITIAL.lock=true). With lock on, editing width rescales height to preserve aspect; unchecking it (first checkbox) lets width move independently. Base is 1000x750 (aspect 1.333); after unlock, width=2000 keeps height=750 so aspect becomes 2000/750=2.667. The visible aspect span proving the toggle worked (RenderDialog.tsx:302-304, useRenderForm.ts:85-97,111).

specs.label: Width (px) input — drives the aspect ratio
specs.note: Width pixel field (#rd-w). Lock is OFF from the previous spec, height set to 768; width=3000 gives aspect 3000/768=3.906, read from the visible aspect span. This is the only text-observable proof a numeric field took effect (the derived unit fields are input values the audit vocabulary cannot read).

specs.label: Height (px) input — drives the aspect ratio
specs.note: Height pixel field (#rd-h). Lock OFF; width reset to 1024, height=1000 gives aspect 1024/1000=1.024 in the aspect span (RenderDialog.tsx:271-278).

specs.label: Width (physical units) input — converts to pixels via dpi
specs.note: Second grid input = width in physical units. At dpi 300, 10 inches -> 3000 px (unitsToPx). Lock OFF, height=768, so aspect becomes 3000/768=3.906, proving the unit->pixel conversion drove width (useRenderForm.ts:61-64,98-99).

specs.label: Height (physical units) input — converts to pixels via dpi
specs.note: Fourth grid input = height in physical units. At dpi 300, 10 inches -> 3000 px. Lock OFF, width=1024, so aspect becomes 1024/3000=0.341 (useRenderForm.ts:100-104).

specs.label: DPI input — accepts a new dots-per-inch value
specs.note: DPI field (#rd-dpi). Per useRenderForm.ts:105-108 changing dpi keeps the SAME pixels (aspect and image size unchanged) and only rescales the derived physical-unit fields — which are input values, not innerText, so the audit's check vocabulary cannot read the effect. This spec verifies the field accepts input without throwing; the numeric conversion itself needs a visual/manual check.

specs.label: Lock aspect ratio checkbox — turn ON preserves the ratio
specs.note: Re-checks the lock (first checkbox, currently OFF). Base is set to 1000x400 (aspect 2.5) while unlocked; after locking, changing width to 1500 rescales height to 600 so the aspect span STILL reads 2.5 — the defining behaviour of the lock (useRenderForm.ts:85-91). Leaves lock ON.

specs.label: Transparent background checkbox — toggles
specs.note: Second checkbox. Its only effect is on a Ray render: it sets opaque_background 0/1 before _bridge.ray (RenderDialog.tsx:149-150,315-321). The bound background result cannot be observed in local mode, so this spec only verifies the toggle clicks without error; the rendered transparency needs remote-backend + a visual check.

specs.label: Units select (inch / cm) — present and clickable
specs.note: Native <select> switching the physical-unit basis (inch factor 1.0, cm factor 2.54; RenderDialog.tsx:295-301, useRenderForm.ts:109). The audit action DSL has no select-option primitive and Playwright fill() cannot set a native <select>, so this spec confirms the control is present and clickable; changing the option and its effect on the derived-unit fields needs a manual/visual pass.

specs.label: Use viewport size button — adopts GL canvas dimensions
specs.note: Calls cmd.get_viewport (works in local mode) and dispatches the viewport size verbatim, lock or no lock (RenderDialog.tsx:131-140,322-324; useRenderForm.ts:115-117). The form is pre-set to a distinctive 2.5:1 aspect (lock ON from prior spec keeps it); adopting the viewport size changes the aspect span to the canvas aspect, a visible DOM change.

specs.label: Close (x) button — collapse dialog back to tab
specs.note: The title-bar IconButton (aria-label 'close Ray / Draw') collapses the panel back to the `.render__tab` button (RenderDialog.tsx:242-249, 244-246 setExpanded(false)). Runs last so the dialog is open for all preceding specs; leaves it collapsed.

specs.label: Draw button — real-time GL render
specs.note: Draw calls _bridge.draw(width,height) then reads the image back and shows the result page (RenderDialog.tsx:142-176,328-335). In local mode '_bridge' is not an addressable namespace (session.ts:305-306), so the call rejects and no render occurs — hence remote-backend + bridge-gl required; recorded BLOCKED here. When available it should reach the result page with a '<w>x<h> complete' status and a preview image.

specs.label: Ray button — CPU ray-traced render
specs.note: Ray sets opaque_background from the transparent checkbox, calls _bridge.ray(width,height), reads the PNG back and shows the result page (RenderDialog.tsx:148-168,336-344). Depends on the bridge's offscreen GL / pixel stream, absent locally -> BLOCKED. When available: result page with 'ray <w>x<h> complete' and a preview.

specs.label: Result page — rendered image preview
specs.note: After a successful Ray/Draw the result page shows the read-back PNG as an (RenderDialog.tsx:355-362). Requires a real render, so BLOCKED in local mode.

specs.label: Result page — save path text input
specs.note: The path field on the result page whose value feeds cmd.png(path) (RenderDialog.tsx:363-370). Reachable only after a render (result page), so BLOCKED locally.

specs.label: Result page — Save with empty path shows guidance
specs.note: Clicking Save with a blank path is a client-side guard that sets status 'enter a path to save to' (RenderDialog.tsx:208-213,371-373). Needs the result page (a prior render) to be reachable, so BLOCKED locally.

specs.label: Result page — Save image writes server-side PNG
specs.note: Save calls cmd.png(path, prior=1, dpi) to write the just-rendered image to the server filesystem (RenderDialog.tsx:208-221). Needs a render AND server-side file service; BLOCKED locally. Expected status 'saved <path>'.

specs.label: Result page — Copy image to clipboard
specs.note: Copy calls cmd.tenmol_files.copy_image_png(dpi) and writes the PNG to the clipboard, or reports 'no prior image' / a clipboard failure (RenderDialog.tsx:178-206,374-381). Needs a prior render (result page); BLOCKED locally. Clipboard also depends on a secure context + user gesture.

specs.label: Result page — Back returns to the setup page
specs.note: The '< Back' button on the result page returns to the size/render setup page (RenderDialog.tsx:383-387 setPage('setup')). Reachable only after a render; BLOCKED locally. Expected: #rd-w visible again.
